    AND ("id_dept" IS NULL)
    AND ("hash_origin" IS NULL))
    OR (("id_org" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("id_dept" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("hash_origin" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ((("id_fdbk" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("id_pharm_review" IS NULL))
    OR (("id_fdbk" IS NULL)
    AND ("id_pharm_review" IS NOT NULL))))
